items.title: Adam and Eve
items.charge: Eating from the tree God forbade

items.title: Alexander the coppersmith
items.charge: Doing Paul much evil; greatly withstanding his words

items.title: Amalek
items.charge: Attacking Israel's stragglers on the way out of Egypt

items.title: Ananias the high priest
items.charge: Commanding Paul to be smitten on the mouth, contrary to the law, while sitting to judge him by the law

items.title: Babylon, the lady of kingdoms
items.charge: Showing no mercy to the captives; saying, I am, and none else beside me; trusting in her sorceries

items.title: Cain
items.charge: Murder of his brother Abel

items.title: Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum
items.charge: Not repenting after the mighty works done in them

items.title: Edom, in the day of his brother
items.charge: Standing on the other side when strangers carried Jacob away; rejoicing over Judah's fall; cutting off those that escaped

items.title: Esau
items.charge: Despising his birthright; marrying Hittite wives; purposing to kill his brother

items.title: Gehazi
items.charge: Greed and lying to a prophet

items.title: Ham and the curse on Canaan
items.charge: Seeing his father's nakedness and telling his brothers

items.title: Hiel the Bethelite
items.charge: Rebuilding Jericho under the oath Joshua swore before the Lord

items.title: Jehoiakim
items.charge: Building with unrighteousness; shedding innocent blood; burning the scroll of the Lord's words

items.title: Jeroboam son of Nebat
items.charge: Two golden calves; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

items.title: Judah robbing God in tithes and offerings
items.charge: Withholding the tithe from the storehouse

items.title: Michal
items.charge: Despising the king in her heart for dancing before the ark

items.title: Reuben
items.charge: Lying with Bilhah, his father's concubine

items.title: Saul and Doeg at Nob
items.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an informer's report

items.title: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
items.charge: Sending letters from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks; prophesying a lie

items.title: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
items.charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city for one man's crime

items.title: The Gibeonites, and Israel's oath
items.charge: Obtaining a covenant by fraud; Israel making it without asking counsel of the Lord

items.title: The priests who despised the Name
items.charge: Offering polluted bread and blemished beasts; being partial in the law

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows' houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: The shepherds of Israel
items.charge: Feeding themselves and not the flock; scattering the sheep

items.title: They that troubled the churches with circumcision
items.charge: Preaching another gospel, subverting souls with a commandment the apostles never gave
